adds.title: Movement Advancement Project - Wyoming's Equality Profile / Equaldex - LGBT Rights in Wyoming
adds.summary: As of October 12, 2026 Wyoming provides no state nondiscrimination protections based on gender identity in public accommodations, housing, employment, and credit/lending, resulting in a gender-identity policy score of -9/25 and overall score of -6.5/47 rated Negative, with the sole noted protection being federal recourse for employment discrimination based on gender identity available nationwide since the June 2020 U.S. Supreme Court ruling through the EEOC and federal courts.

adds.title: Aruba Criminal Code (Wetboek van Strafrecht; Kódigo Penal), enacted 2012, Articles 1:221, 2:61 and 2:62
adds.summary: Aruba's Criminal Code enacted in 2012 defines discrimination in Article 1:221 and in Articles 2:61-2:62 criminalizes group insult, incitement to hatred, discrimination or violence, and discrimination in office, profession or business on grounds including sex/geslacht and hetero- or homosexual orientation, with no explicit protection for gender identity or gender expression.
